title: Promise
summary: Unobtainable +1 dagger with advantage on obscured melee targets.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus applicable ability modifier. +1 to attack rolls. Simple one-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light and Thrown.
fields.Shadow Blade: Advantage on melee weapon attacks against lightly or heavily obscured targets, including with an equipped second melee weapon.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing removes it. Standard modes add 2 Piercing on hits. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original damage type to any source.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
